evidence_excerpts: The open research directions go beyond predicting the best optimisations to apply. One central issue is what does the program space look like?
Can machine learning also be applied to compiler analysis? For instance is it possible to learn dataflow or point-to analysis? ... Can we learn the ideal compiler intermediate representation?
text: Future research in machine-learning compilation extends beyond choosing optimizations to mapping program and hardware spaces, learning analyses, discovering common features, and possibly learning better intermediate representations.
